title: inference.put_groq
description:
Create a Groq inference endpoint.

Create an inference endpoint to perform an inference task with the `groq` service.

timeout.description: Specifies the amount of time to wait for the inference endpoint to be created.

service.description: The type of service supported for the specified task type. In this case, `groq`.

service_settings.description: Settings used to install the inference model. These settings are specific to the `groq` service.

task_type.description: The type of the inference task that the model will perform.

groq_inference_id.description: The unique identifier of the inference endpoint.
